kjv.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

bsb.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

web.text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

leads.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

reasons: names “Paul”, who is not in the block

flow.say: Henry shows us that Paul calls Christians to find their deepest joy in God himself, not in circumstances.
This joy must fill all our thoughts about God and stay with us through every season of life.
Even hardship and suffering cannot take away the joy we find in God, because he is enough in every condition.
Henry notes that Paul repeats this command because rejoicing in God is so important that Christians need constant reminding.

morning.say: Carry into today the truth that God himself is enough to give you joy right now.
morning.phrase: There is enough in God to furnish us with matter of joy
